headline: Stocks are bouncing from an AI-led selloff in a holiday-shortened session while Middle East supply attacks keep oil elevated and a December Fed hike is all but priced in.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield is roughly 4.85-4.9% (sources differ on today's direction) and markets see a quarter-point hike at the Dec. 8-9 meeting as nearly certain.
fed: No Fed decision this week; the one scheduled appearance found is Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman's House testimony on Tuesday, Dec. 1 at 10 AM ET.
oil: Brent is around $97 and on track for its first weekly gain in weeks after attacks on Hormuz tankers and Saudi energy sites, with OPEC+ meeting Sunday and expected to keep targets unchanged.
geo: The Iran conflict is the live shock (Hormuz still disrupted, Saudi Jazan refinery hit, Kuwait reporting an Iranian drone strike that Iran denies), alongside new US Section 301 tariff proposals on 14 economies.
